name: Imazu 04 -- crossing from port
description: Canonical Imazu problem 4 (Sawada/Zhai Appendix D reconstruction), reproduced with the exact own-ship/target start positions, headings, and speeds from the reference scenario in Data/Imazu Missions/imazu/imazu/04/04.ini -- kept geometrically identical to the published benchmark so results can be compared directly against other papers using the same Imazu case. ts1 crosses from port (broad).
pass_criteria: Own-ship holds course/speed as stand-on for the target(s) crossing from port, only acting under Rule 17(b) if the other vessel clearly fails to act.
Minimum CPA to ALL targets stays above the safe-distance threshold.
